questions.topic: Topic 1 — Device Scope, Classification, and Submission Structure
questions.subject: Bundling the Drug Library Manager SaMD accessory
questions.position: We propose bundling it as an accessory within the PP3500 filing, with its own design-control record, because its safety role is inseparable from the pump's dose enforcement.

questions.topic: Topic 1 — Device Scope, Classification, and Submission Structure
questions.subject: Connectivity Adapter as Non-Device MDDS
questions.position: We classify the adapter as Non-Device MDDS (post-2015 reclassification) and will identify it as adjacent infrastructure in the 510(k) without expanding the device boundary.

questions.topic: Topic 1 — Device Scope, Classification, and Submission Structure
questions.subject: Product code and submission structure
questions.position: We expect to carry the predicate's PCA infusion-pump product code and file a single 510(k) + PCCP.

questions.subject: Single PCCP spanning three change families
questions.position: A unified PCCP with per-category modification protocols, bounded by the Ct*-tagged change envelope, is the most coherent structure.

questions.subject: Acceptance criteria for drug-library updates
questions.position: We propose validation against the formulary source of truth plus regression of the pump's limit-enforcement behavior; numeric thresholds are pending FDA input.

questions.subject: PP3000 substantial equivalence with added connectivity
questions.position: PP3000 is the primary predicate; the added functions are addressed by the separation architecture and the PCCP envelope.
